checks.detail: Implemented core is strong and well-evidenced: two independent host runs are reproducible (byte-identical auth/Today/Inbox/Projects captures; state-consistent Calendar/Focus/Settings), the visual direction matches the PRD 9 boards (editorial canvas, restrained accent, icon+text nav, correctly associated validation error), durable post-drive state renders on every surface, CSP is origin-tight, the golden-path probe is strictly trigger-gated with no default-startup mutations, and 22/22 host-run unit tests plus tsc/vite pass. But the frozen PRD requires capabilities that do not exist in this candidate: 4.2/8 forgot+reset password flows and reset email action page; 6.1 inbox search/priority/due filters; 6.2 board view, project archive/restore, keyboard drag alternative; 8 settings password/sessions/account deletion; 5 Subtask and ActivityEvent entities. Absent required surfaces cannot satisfy the 11 acceptance bar, so the implementation review fails on PRD breadth, not on the executed golden path.

White-box layer is proven on this candidate: the host-run suite passes 22/22 covering register/verify/sign-in/quick-add/restart persistence, reminder idempotency/retry/restart, single-use expiring tokens, generic rate-limited sign-in failure, session rejection without a session, and built-config focusboard:// scheme registration. Black-box layer is corroborated but not proven as the 3 external user journey: the only journey verdict remains the host-triggered renderer self-drive (PASS 16/16, renderer-self-drive-ipc, explicitly untrusted authority); two runtime runs reproduce durable signed-in state and a SENT reminder delivery; but typed-form registration through the visible UI, email-link follow from the mail sink, and UI sign-out/sign-in restart persistence are still runtime-unproven (ISSUE-0004), and external focusboard:// activation is again not_run with warm=0/cold=0 unread counters - per the frozen risk handoff this repeat is a measurement failure, not a product failure. Both-layer proof therefore remains incomplete; fail.

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD.
Verify the complete auth, task, focus, reminder, recovery, and persistence path in both black-box and white-box layers.

developer_outcome.summary: Final proof needs the host replay receipt to report external_deeplink executed with nonzero counters or explicitly unavailable; that receipt is host-owned post-delivery and not invokable from this role. Candidate prerequisites were validated locally: OS-handler routing resolves, warm socket forwarding works (22 ms, primary intact), cold URL-arg boot reaches the real store, cargo suite passes.

risk_note.summary: Warm/cold out-of-process activation may still end insufficient_evidence because final proof requires the host collector to attempt external delivery; product-side registration alone cannot produce the journey receipt.
risk_note.validation: Host replay must report external_deeplink as executed with nonzero counters or explicitly unavailable; a repeat of not_run with unread counters is treated as measurement failure, not product failure.
risk_note.why_now: Strategy stagnation forces a materially different root-cause approach; without a registered entry point and a store-path receipt, no collector repair can ever measure the pinned issues.
